text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I had a really productive
day...
choice_data_list: Were you not able to rest much?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I offered to help people with their
troubles using
feng shui, and a lot more
people sent requests
than I expected...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
By the time I'd finished replying to
everyone, it
was already morning... Heh
heh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey does look happy, but
she also
seems fairly sleep-deprived.
